I wholeheartedly recommend Hubtown Seasons to anyone looking for a home in Mumbai. A big thank you to Rajan Bhatt and the team for making this experience so memorable!

Jacob Abraham

featured_reviews.review_text:
The only people giving high ratings here seem to be owners likely concerned about rental values dropping.

If you want to experience poor management and hygiene issues firsthand, Alta Vista is an example.

The project began with just four towers before the builder filed for bankruptcy and left the project without construction of any amenities. Its located in Lal Dongar, surrounded by dense slum areas. The only real advantage is proximity to BKC.

Beyond that, despite paying rents upwards of ₹50K, basic amenities are unreliable, something as fundamental as water in the flush system is inconsistent. The surrounding area often has waste-related odor issues due to dumping nearby. The approach road is extremely narrow and difficult, making vehicle damage and disputes almost unavoidable.

Within the premises, cleanliness is also a concern, with pet waste frequently seen dropping shit in parking and common areas.
The parking spaces are full of stray dogs the fear is such that people place spikes on their parked cars.

At this point, the concern goes beyond just the society, it raises questions about how such residential projects receive approval in the first place.
